title: Brewing Class
description: Lets you teach your friends BreweryX recipes
body:
### This is a [BreweryX](https://modrinth.com/plugin/breweryx) addon, not a plugin!




This is a addon for a [addon](https://modrinth.com/plugin/breweryrecipesaddon) for [BreweryX](https://modrinth.com/plugin/breweryx) 
THIS WILL NOT WORK BY ITSELF!

Using this addon you can teach your friends brewing recipes using ```/brew teach <recipe>```


please note that you actually have to own the recipe to teach it.

you need the permission
```brewery.brewingclass.teach```
so make sure to add it to your default group


this is my first ~~plugin~~ addon so it will probally be scuffed as all hell.
